paraphrase: Five kinds of insanity have been told. Of the senses and their activity, the mind (manas), located between the head and the palate, is supreme over all the senses; seated there it knows the senses' objects near it and governs the three states (bhāvas); strength consisting of all the senses arises from the mind; the cause of all cognitions is citta, which rests in the heart; citta is the cause of all actions — those of good citta go on the good path, those of bad citta go astray.
